title: OTWONO AI Backend Protocol
description: The contract between otwono-aid and an AI backend adapter process: newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on the adapter's stdin/stdout, framed and supervised by otwono-ai::supervisor. The first line the adapter writes is a hello; every line after that is a JSON-RPC response to a request the daemon sent. This is a process boundary and a language boundary — an adapter need not be written in Rust — so it is a schema and not a Rust trait.

hello.title: Backend hello
hello.description: The adapter's first line, written before any model is loaded. Loading can take minutes on small hardware; saying hello first is what lets the supervisor's hello timeout stay short enough to distinguish a dead adapter from a slow one.

protocol.description: Protocol version the adapter implements. A mismatch is refused at spawn rather than at first inference.

version.description: Engine version, for ai.capabilities and for bug reports. "unknown" when the adapter could not determine it, which is not a failure.

load_params.title: backend.load params
load_params.description: Load a model, replacing whatever was loaded before. One model at a time: holding several would mean the adapter dividing memory between them, and that decision belongs to admission control, which sits above and sees the whole node's budget.

context_tokens.description: Context window to reserve. Admission control already charged the node's memory budget for exactly this number, so it is not a hint the engine may round up.

gpu_layers.description: Layers to offload to an accelerator. Null leaves the engine's default.

load_ms.description: Spawn to healthy, in milliseconds. Reported rather than inferred: load time is the number users notice on small hardware.

max_tokens.description: Required, not defaulted: an unbounded generation occupies the node's only engine for as long as the model keeps talking.

stop_reason.description: Why generation stopped. token_limit means the answer is cut off, and a caller that renders it without saying so is lying to the user by omission.

prompt_truncated.description: Whether the engine dropped part of the prompt to fit the context window.

model_path.description: Null when no model is loaded, which is the state the adapter starts in. Null, not an empty string: a caller must not have to guess which of the two means "nothing".

unloaded.description: False when nothing was loaded. Unloading nothing succeeds; it is not an error to ask for a state you are already in.

$comment: A library of message definitions, not a single-instance schema: each frame is validated against the $defs entry for its method. The Rust types are in otwono-llama's protocol module and the hello in otwono-ai's supervisor; tests/schema/tests/ai_backend_protocol_schema.rs checks that what those types actually serialize matches what is written here.
